theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_density_locally_constant
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → ∀ p ∈ C.support, p ≠ 0 → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball p δ → HasMassDensity C y k
